definitions.explanation: A flat scoop-like tool used with a broom to collect swept-up dirt and debris.

examples.japanese: ⟦{箒|ほうき}→箒：03910_houki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{塵取|ちりと}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To clean with a broom and dustpan.

examples.japanese: {塵取|ちりと}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: I gathered the trash with a dustpan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{箒|ほうき}→箒：03910_houki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{塵取|ちりと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧きて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to clean the entrance, so please bring the broom and dustpan.

notes:
A flat scoop used with a broom to collect swept-up dust and debris. Almost always mentioned together with ⟦{箒|ほうき}→箒：03910_houki⟧ (broom).

FORMS:
⟦{塵|ちり}→塵：12107_chiri⟧ (dust, dirt) + ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (collecting). Often written in hiragana as ちりとり in everyday contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{箒|ほうき}→箒：03910_houki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{塵取|ちりと}り: broom and dustpan (natural set phrase)
- {塵取|ちりと}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to collect trash with a dustpan
- {塵取|ちりと}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掃|は}き→掃く：04260_haku⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to sweep into the dustpan

CULTURAL NOTE:
Still commonly used in Japanese schools, where students clean their own classrooms (⟦{掃除|そうじ}{当番|とうばん}→掃除当番：14990_soujitouban⟧) with brooms and dustpans rather than vacuum cleaners.
